post.description: One page of observations from an EIA route (`<route>/data`) at a frequency, filtered by facet codes and a period range, sorted, with offset pagination up to 5000 rows per page. Each record carries the period, every facet as {code, name}, requested values as source strings, units copied from the source, extra source flags, and the series id when the route has one. Period formats follow the frequency (YYYY, YYYY-Qn, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH).

api_key.description: Registered EIA API key. Omitted, the public data-browser key is discovered live (see `routes`). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page (a row offset). Omit for the first page. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}$.

data_columns.description: Data columns to return, from the route's `data_columns`. Defaults to ["value"].

end.description: Inclusive last period in the frequency's format.

facets.description: Facet filters: facet id to list of codes, e.g. {"series": ["RWTC"]} or {"stateid": ["CA"], "sectorid": ["RES"]}.

frequency.description: Frequency id from the route metadata: annual, quarterly, monthly, weekly, daily, hourly or local-hourly. Pattern: ^[a-z-]+$.

page_size.description:
Rows per page; the API caps a page at 5000 rows.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 5000; default 20.

route.description: Route path with data, such as `petroleum/pri/spt` (do not append `/data`). Pattern: ^/?[a-z0-9_-]+(/[a-z0-9_-]+)*/?$.

sort.description: Sort keys applied by the API. Defaults to newest period first.

start.description: Inclusive first period in the frequency's format.

post.description: Navigate the EIA API v2 route hierarchy. Given a route path (or none for the root) returns that route's metadata: child routes, frequencies with period formats, facet ids and data columns with units. Use it to find the route, frequency, facets and columns that `data` needs.

api_key.description: Registered EIA API key (free at https://www.eia.gov/opendata/register.php). Omitted, the workflow discovers live the public client key EIA serves inside its own data browser (two extra requests, shared quota) and falls back to api.data.gov's DEMO_KEY (10 requests/hour/IP) with a warning. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from a previous page of child routes. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}$.

page_size.description:
Child routes per page (the API returns all children at once; pages are cut here).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000; default 500.

path.description: Route path such as `electricity/retail-sales`. Omit or null for the top-level route list. Pattern: ^/?[a-z0-9_-]+(/[a-z0-9_-]+)*/?$|^/?$.

records.description:

records.name: International

records.description:
Estimated production, consumption, price, and expenditure data for all energy sources by state and sector.  
        Source:  https://www.eia.gov/state/seds/seds-technical-notes-complete.php  
        Product:  SEDS (https://www.eia.gov/state/seds/)
records.name: State Energy Data System (SEDS)

records.description:
Monthly short term (18 month) projections using STEO model.  
        Report and interactive projection data browser:  STEO (www.eia.gov/steo/)
records.name: Short Term Energy Outlook

records.description: These data represent the most recent comprehensive energy statistics integrated across all energy sources.  The data includes total energy production, consumption, stocks, and trade; energy prices; overviews of petroleum, natural gas, coal, electricity, nuclear energy, renewable energy, and carbon dioxide emissions; and data unit conversions values.  Source: https://www.eia.gov/totalenergy/data/monthly/pdf/mer_a_doc.pdf  Report:  MER (https://www.eia.gov/totalenergy/data/monthly/)
records.name: Total Energy

records.description: Annual U.S. projections using National Energy Modelling System (NEMS) for release year.  Report, documentation, and interactive projection data browser:  AEO (www.eia.gov/aeo/)
records.name: Annual Energy Outlook

records.description: Annual international projections using the World Energy Projection System (WEPS) model for release year.  Report and interactive projection data browser:  IEO (www.eia.gov/ieo/)
records.name: International Energy Outlook
